scope: Tampermonkey Chrome 5.5.1 functional compatibility and video-box auxiliary Play
implementation: Real extension-origin WKWebView offscreen document with one-document enforcement, validated bundled HTML paths, permission checks and shutdown cleanup.
Private bounded structured-message transport for Blob, ArrayBuffer and typed arrays; actual document DOM and message handler execute.
Publisher Content Script mode for the exact verified Tampermonkey background hash; static page/content bootstrap uses WebKit extension isolation and host grants.
Native extension URL scheme, startup listener timing, conservative host-permission query normalization and finite DNR alternative expansion.
Persist extension-instance installation lifecycle so duplicate WebKit install events do not quarantine previously installed scripts; first install, version updates and uninstall remain distinct.
Retain the original background source; preparation is idempotent and preserves subsequent unknown source edits.
Auxiliary Play shares the original 40-point video tool surface, corner radius, icon dimensions and translucent styling; tracks a known player box and hides when it scrolls out of view.
Normal video tools and auxiliary Play are mutually exclusive; placement generations reject stale frame messages. A page-corner fallback remains only when no video box is identifiable.
offscreenTests: path traversal and remote URL rejection

limits: Native WebExtensions still require iOS 18.4 or later. Built-in userscripts are a separate existing runtime.
This does not implement the complete Chrome userScripts API. The verified Tampermonkey port uses the publisher Content Script path, not a fake API success shim.
The adapter recognizes the exact official Chrome 5.5.1 background hash; other versions and Firefox/Safari packages have not been functionally certified.
runtime.getContexts compatibility enumerates explicit OFFSCREEN_DOCUMENT queries only. Desktop-only offscreen reasons and unrestricted background execution are not supplied.
Structured offscreen messages have a 16 MiB payload limit, depth and complexity bounds; circular objects and unsupported structured values reject.
The user-specific failing script and package version were not supplied; arbitrary GM APIs, every script and external-site behavior are not certified.
Storage restoration is checked after the script manager commits its backing store; terminating an in-flight write is not treated as a committed save.
supersedes: The native API matrix in 2026-11-12-webextension-tampermonkey-capability.json remains a historical native-surface probe. Its pre-change fake-offscreen and no-functional-test conclusions are superseded by this report.
